svg.title: The Velvet Room
svg.desc: The Velvet Room, a hidden room behind every inn, grows with the story. Until Repeating Tom's news at step 4 the ways in are closed; then the Sepikmon arrives (Super Rare hunts and hero skins); at step 10, The Suzaku Badge, Igor the host and Gennai with the Blast quest; at step 16, The real Leader, Guilmon with the Demon Bell (Super Hard); at step 22, Free Asuka City, Etemon and the pig; and once Oikawa is beaten, step 27, his Black Market. At step 40, before the point of no return, it becomes the Time Room: three trials, no prize. At New Game Igor hands you the key, and in four dreams he asks a question and remembers your answer. The way in: a piece of each inn's scenery glows a faint, breathing blue; stand on it, the up-arrow prompt shows, press CIRCLE.
svg.text: The room grows with the story
A hidden room behind every inn. Its guests arrive as the story moves on.
In every inn, one piece of the scenery glows a faint
blue. Stand on it and press CIRCLE. Open from step 4.
tells which DNA forms your partners
could reach, and what each still needs.
Four times he pulls you in alone and
asks; later dreams recall your answer.
Before the point of no return, three
trials check you are ready. No prize.
